protocol:
1. Arrange the bench with labeled microcentrifuge tubes on ice, a white tube rack, sterile pipette tips, a waste beaker, an adjustable micropipette, an Invitrogen E-Gel EX gel cassette, and an Invitrogen E-Gel Power Snap instrument.

2. Remove a labeled microcentrifuge tube from the ice bucket and pipette a clear liquid aliquot using a sterile tip; no volume setting is legible.

3. Dispense the aliquot into a labeled microcentrifuge tube and keep the tube in the rack or on ice.

4. Repeat aliquoting for the remaining labeled tubes, changing pipette tips between tubes and discarding used tips into the waste beaker.

5. Load the prepared clear liquid samples into the wells of the Invitrogen E-Gel EX cassette using the adjustable micropipette; no loading volume or lane map is visible.

6. Insert the E-Gel EX cassette into the Invitrogen E-Gel Power Snap instrument and seat it in the red/amber gel bay.

7. Close the E-Gel Power Snap cover and use the touchscreen to initiate the E-Gel run or imaging program.
